outputs.explanation: Panel A shows photographs of lungs (bright-field and ICG fluorescence), not a plot of averaged data; individual data points are not applicable.
Bar graph of ICG mean fluorescence intensity displays individual data points (blue dots for No Cre, red dots for Adeno Cre) overlaid on the bars, alongside mean ± SD.
Panel C contains micrographs (H&E, ICG, RNAscope) plus spatial heatmap-style plots of Cd68 and Spp1 transcript expression across tissue spots; heatmaps do not require individual data point overlays.
Panel D shows GSEA enrichment line plots; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement as overlaying points would make them unreadable.

Bar graph shows log2 fold-change values for genes derived from differential gene expression analysis (Seurat FindMarkers, Wilcoxon test across many spatial transcriptomic spots) with p-values annotated; this is a computed group-level statistic from a pooled/DEG comparison rather than a mean across discrete biological replicates, so individual data points are not applicable/practical here.
Panel F shows fluorescence and IHC photographic/micrograph images, not a plot of averaged quantitative data; individual data points are not applicable.
